final:
pad2(n: int) -> str =
  pre n >= 0
  if n < 10
    "0\(n)"
  else
    "\(n)"

stamp(ts: int) -> str =
  pre ts >= 0
  post out.char_count() == 8
  ex stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  ex stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  let sec = ts % 86400
  let h = sec // 3600
  let m = (sec % 3600) // 60
  let s = sec % 60
  let hh = pad2(h)
  let mm = pad2(m)
  let ss = pad2(s)
  "\(hh):\(mm):\(ss)"

test_stamp() =
  assert stamp(0) == "00:00:00"
  assert stamp(3661) == "01:01:01"
  assert stamp(86399) == "23:59:59"
  assert stamp(86400) == "00:00:00"
